title: Diorama UI manifest
description: The source of truth for everything this design system distributes. registry.json and r/*.json are generated from this file — see scripts/build-registry.mjs.

renamed.description: Old item name → new item name. Ledger history is immutable, so entries written under an old name stay valid (check:ledger accepts the keys). ADR 0027.

name.description: Kebab-case. This is what a consumer types: @bydiorama/<name>.

type.description: Mapped to registry:<type> in the generated registry. `skill` is the exception: skills ship in the `ui` agent plugin (plugins/ui), not through the registry (ADR 0027).

target.description: Path inside the consuming app — or, for a `skill`, inside this repo's plugin (`plugins/ui/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, ADR 0027). Alias-shaped (`ui/button.tsx`): the first segment is a key in the consumer's components.json `aliases`. Literal: a first segment starting with `.` (`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) or a `~/` prefix (`~/public/...`, shadcn's project-root marker) is a path from the consumer root, used as-is. A non-dot root path like `public/...` without `~/` is read as an alias and fails. Never `..` or absolute.

dependencies.description: npm packages the consumer must install.

registryDependencies.description: Other items in this manifest, by name.

docs.description: Repo-relative path to the item's typed doc file.
